opportunities.title: Ivanti Connect Secure: Zero-Day #3 and #4 Drop While Attackers Already Have Root — Patch Timeline Nobody Can Keep Up With

opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence breakdown: timeline of the four CVEs, what 'chained' actually means for defenders, and why VPN appliances keep being the softest target

opportunities.title: The Blockchain Cops Got Hacked: Chainalysis Breach Used 'Offensive Agentic Techniques'
opportunities.why_now: Chainalysis — the firm law enforcement relies on to trace crypto crime — just confirmed an AI-driven intrusion exposed customer identity data, a stark irony worth unpacking now.
opportunities.angle: Irony-driven breach digest entry: what 'offensive agentic techniques' means in practice and what it signals about AI-assisted red teaming turning into AI-assisted attacks

opportunities.title: A Trojanized 'Claude Code' Extension Planted SSH Backdoors — and Anthropic Says Don't Blame Us

opportunities.angle: Supply-chain explainer: how the fake extension got distributed, what it dropped, and the attribution dispute between devs and Anthropic

opportunities.title: Meet VOLTA: The Infostealer That Asks Claude, Gemini, and Kimi Which Victims Are Worth Stealing From
opportunities.why_now: A newly documented infostealer is using multiple commercial AI models to automatically triage stolen data by victim financial value, a first-of-its-kind escalation reported Nov 2.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor deep dive on AI-weaponization: how VOLTA queries LLMs mid-attack, what it means for detection, and the broader trend of crimeware renting legitimate AI APIs

opportunities.title: FBI Finally Puts a Name on the $6.43 Billion Binance Heist: TraderTraitor, North Korea's Record-Breaking Crew

opportunities.angle: Attribution breakdown: how the FBI traced it, what the 600+ addresses reveal about DPRK laundering infrastructure, and why this dwarfs every prior crypto heist on record
